headline: 30-year fixed mortgage rate tops 7% for the first time in over a year
detail: Rising mortgage rates signal tighter monetary conditions and higher borrowing costs. This can cool economic activity and consumer spending, which often negatively impacts growth-oriented tech and chip companies. For you, on margin, this means a tougher environment for your concentrated portfolio.
rec: Consider trimming positions like QQQ or SMH, which are already on TRIM status, to reduce overall market exposure in a rising rate environment.

headline: 10-year Treasury yield tops 4.9%, highest since 2023, as oil surge raises inflation fears
detail: Higher Treasury yields make riskier assets like tech stocks less attractive, as investors can get better returns from safer government bonds. Inflation fears could lead to further rate hikes, increasing pressure on your highly concentrated, margin-fueled tech/chip portfolio.
rec: Given the increased risk from rising yields and inflation fears, review your leveraged positions like SOXL and SPAL. Ensure their stops are appropriate for risk management, not targets.
